description: Kenya - Transmission Stations is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Rhonda Jordan Antoine; Patrick Balla; Laurencia Njagi; Sudeshna Banerjee. (World Bank Group). The data contains transmission station locations in Kenya. The dataset was provided by Kenya Power and Lighting Company (KPLC). Coverage: Kenya. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Energy access, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
